executed_prefix.protocol: Raw teacher-forced predictions; episode-local nonoverlapping prefixes; each valid action once; training episodes measure fitting only.
executed_prefix.baseline_contract: Hold uses observed pose/joints and gripper at the inference anchor; persistence repeats the prior achieved delta/recorded target and holds the anchor gripper. Tool deltas are transported between observed tool frames. Neither uses future observations.
executed_prefix.geometry_caution: Cartesian metrics inherit the prepared FK calibration; joint metrics are degrees, not Cartesian task error.

offline_selection.weights: equal mean of available components; thresholds fixed before training
offline_selection.scope: offline shortlist only; same split, targets, normalization and component availability required for comparison
offline_selection.promotion: requires bounded common development rollouts, then frozen reserved evaluation; offline score establishes no task success
